mapper.select: select t.id, t.yjcode as yj_type, nvl((case when (t.yjcode='105' or t.yjcode='120' or t.yjcode='161') then t.yj_record else yj_object end ),'') as yj_record, t.zbcode,t.yj_msg, t.yj_amt, t.yj_tax, t.cl_date, t.cl_msg, dy.yjname, dy.swjg_fw, t.yj_count as ldlp_qnt, t.yj_object from tl_admin.yj_data_yjxx t inner join tl_admin.yj_dic_code dy on t.yjcode = dy.yjcode inner join tl_admin.YJ_SBXX_HZ h on t.sbid = h.id and h.id = #{sbid, jdbcType = DECIMAL} order by t.yjcode

SELECT NVL(SUM(YTSE_1),0) FROM ( SELECT HZ.YTSE_1, HZ.MDSE FROM HX_CKTS.CKTS_TY_YWBLXX YW, HX_CKTS.CKTS_SB_MDT_SBHZ_JGB HZ WHERE YW.DJXH = #{djxh} AND YW.LCSWSX_DM = 'LCSXA081038001' AND YW.LCSLID = HZ.LCSLID AND YW.QDSJ BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{firstDay},'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE(#{lastDay},'YYYY-MM-DD') AND YW.ZFBZ_1 IS NULL AND YW.HTBZ_1 IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT HZ.YTSE_1, HZ.MDSE FROM HX_CKTS.CKTS_TY_YWBLXX YW, HX_CKTS.CKTS_SB_MDT_SBHZ_GCB HZ WHERE YW.DJXH = #{djxh} AND YW.LCSWSX_DM = 'LCSXA081038001' AND YW.LCSLID = HZ.LCSLID AND YW.QDSJ BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{firstDay},'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE(#{lastDay},'YYYY-MM-DD') AND YW.ssq||YW.sbpc != #{sbnypc} AND YW.ZFBZ_1 IS NULL AND YW.HTBZ_1 IS NULL)

SELECT NVL(SUM(TSE),0) FROM (SELECT HZ.TSE FROM HX_CKTS.CKTS_TY_YWBLXX YW, HX_CKTS.CKTS_SB_MTS_TSJH_JGB HZ WHERE YW.DJXH = #{djxh} AND YW.LCSWSX_DM = 'LCSXA081039001' AND YW.LCSLID = HZ.LCSLID AND YW.QDSJ BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{firstDay},'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE(#{lastDay},'YYYY-MM-DD') AND YW.ZFBZ_1 IS NULL AND YW.HTBZ_1 IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT HZ.TSE FROM HX_CKTS.CKTS_TY_YWBLXX YW, HX_CKTS.CKTS_SB_MTS_TSJH_GCB HZ WHERE YW.DJXH = #{djxh} AND YW.LCSWSX_DM = 'LCSXA081039001' AND YW.LCSLID = HZ.LCSLID AND YW.QDSJ BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{firstDay},'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE(#{lastDay},'YYYY-MM-DD') AND YW.ssq||YW.sbpc != #{sbnypc} AND YW.ZFBZ_1 IS NULL AND YW.HTBZ_1 IS NULL)
